WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( UPPER(T1.TX_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(T1.TX_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(T1.APP_ID, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(T1.PATH_URL, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(T1.HTTP_METHOD, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
AND T1.TX_ID = #{txId}
AND T1.TX_NAME LIKE '%' || #{txName} || '%'
AND T1.APP_ID LIKE '%' || #{appId} || '%'
AND UPPER(T1.HTTP_METHOD) = UPPER(#{httpMethod})

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.*, ROWNUM rnum FROM ( SELECT /* mgcoa9000S0_S0 */ T1.TX_ID AS TX_ID , T1.TX_NAME AS TX_NAME , T1.APP_ID AS APP_ID , T1.PATH_URL AS PATH_URL , T1.HTTP_METHOD AS HTTP_METHOD , T1.REG_USER_ID AS REG_USER_ID , T1.REG_DTM AS REG_DTM , T1.CHG_USER_ID AS CHG_USER_ID , T1.CHG_DTM AS CHG_DTM FROM TB_MG_TX_PARAM T1
ORDER BY T1.REG_DTM DESC, T1.TX_ID ASC ) a WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{pageSize} ) WHERE rnum > #{offset}
SELECT /* mgcoa9000S0_S0_count */ COUNT(*) FROM TB_MG_TX_PARAM T1
